books.title: Dare to Lead
books.author: Brené Brown
books.description: Brené Brown explores vulnerability as the cornerstone of bold leadership.
books.summary: Brené Brown argues that courageous leadership grows from vulnerability, empathy, and meaningful connection. By choosing courage over comfort, teams create cultures where hard conversations happen and new ideas are safe to explore.
keyTakeaways: Vulnerability is not weakness—it is the birthplace of innovation and trust.

books.title: Why We Sleep
books.author: Matthew Walker
books.description: Matthew Walker on the science-backed benefits of prioritizing sleep.
books.summary: Neuroscientist Matthew Walker makes the case for sleep as the single most effective step we can take toward improved health, productivity, and longevity. Optimizing sleep unlocks learning, creativity, immune support, and emotional balance.
keyTakeaways: Treat seven to nine hours as a non-negotiable upgrade to every system in your body.
Consistency matters: hold a steady sleep and wake time—even on weekends.
Create a wind-down routine and sleep environment that keeps light, temperature, and caffeine in check.
